pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Look for Ribbit villages in swamps; maracas occur in their trade. Do not expect plants removed from current offers; use the actual trade screen.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Find a Ribbit swamp village and trade with merchant or fisherman Ribbits. Trades provide native plant blocks and maracas.
